Members

CYRILLIC_SLUG

Russian Cyrillic → Latin transliteration — Cyrillic media labels would otherwise slugify to '' and lose their deep-link URL. MUST stay byte-identical to CYRILLIC_SLUG in core/utils/string.ts.

slugify

Media-slug transform — MUST match generate-sitemap.js's slugify byte for byte: emitted /portfolio// file names have to line up with the URLs the sitemap already lists (diacritics fold to ASCII).

esc

Escape a string for use inside an HTML attribute or text node.

toDescription

Strips markup from a translated rich-text string and compacts it into a meta-description-sized plain-text snippet (≤160 chars, cut at a word boundary).   entities decode to regular spaces so the tag can sit in a content attribute.

breadcrumbEntity

Ordered crumbs → BreadcrumbList entity (positions are 1-based per spec).

videoEntity

VideoObject for one media descriptor — mp4 contentUrl + poster thumb.

(module scope)

Recursively yields every sections node that carries a src.

writeCompressed

Brotil + gzip siblings next to each emitted index.html (Firebase serves them).

localize

Rewrites the English shell into a localized document.
